name: Bouringujou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional bowling alley (Sakura Bowl): a notice about lane reservation hours changing, a first day working reception, a fee-and-shoe-rental guide, a first time bowling experience, a comparison of two new-staff training plans, a column on getting nervous during a company outing, teaching a new staff member how to hand out shoes, an explanation of why bowling scoring looks complicated, a lane-maintenance closure notice, a column on tailoring service to each customer's experience level, a notice of revised membership rules, an essay on remembering a first thrown ball, and a one-year cooperation report on a local seniors' bowling class. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
